sections.heading: Opening

Per the file, we intend to fully (per the file) engage with network stakeholders (per the file) throughout the implementation phases (per the file) \(i.e. pre-testnet, testnet, mainnet\) (per the file) to ensure the system supports, and (per the file) is representative of, the various network (per the file) participants' interests. Per the file, the first step toward (per the file) this goal, however, is (per the file) outlining a some desired (per the file) MVP economic features to (per the file) be available for early (per the file) pre-testnet and testnet participants.
